steps.name: seed
steps.file:
# my Kimi Code config
default_model = "kimi-code/k2.7"

[thinking]
effort = "high"

# said when a turn ends
[[hooks]]
event = "Stop"
command = "say done"

[[hooks]]
event = "PostToolUse"
matcher = "Bash"
command = "my-log"

steps.name: save turn-end
steps.file:
# my Kimi Code config
default_model = "kimi-code/k2.7"

[thinking]
effort = "high"

# said when a turn ends
[[hooks]]
event = "Stop"
command = "say done"

[[hooks]]
event = "PostToolUse"
matcher = "Bash"
command = "my-log"

[[hooks]]
event = "Stop"
command = "curl -s https://api.day.app/KEY/done"
timeout = 10
